title: Booking a Room for a Family Lunch
transcript:
Hello. I'm calling about hiring a room on Sunday the twenty-fourth. It's my mother's birthday, and there will be about eighteen of us. We were hoping to bring our own lunch rather than arrange catering.
That should be fine. The main hall is available, but you'd be paying for space you won't use. I'd suggest the upstairs meeting room. It seats twenty comfortably, and you can bring food into it.
That sounds about right. One of our guests uses a walking frame, though. Your website mentions a lift, but the photos all seem to have been taken from the steps at the front.
The lift is working. Tell your guest to come in through the side entrance. It's at street level, and there is a sign to the lift just inside. The front door is the one with steps.
Great. We're thinking of eating around one. Would we be allowed to set up before then? We only need to arrange the tables and put the food out, so half an hour should be enough.
Yes. I'll start the booking at half past twelve. You'll have the room until four. Could you fill out the booking form on our website this evening? It asks how you'd like the tables arranged.
I can do that. While I've got you, what does the hire charge actually cover? For instance, do we have to bring our own cups and plates, or are those available in the building?
There are cups and plates in the kitchen cupboard, and you can use them without paying anything extra. We do ask groups to wash them and put them away before leaving.
That's helpful. I noticed a note about a key deposit. Does someone have to come to the office on Friday to collect a key? Most of us will be at work then.
That's for bookings after the centre closes. There will be a member of staff here on Sunday afternoon, so just speak to the person at reception when you arrive. They'll open the room for you.
All right. I'll send the form when I get home. Is there anything else you need to know now, or can I give you the names and phone number online?
Online is fine. Just enter one number for the whole group. I'll hold the room until tomorrow morning, and you'll get an email once I've checked the form.

questions.prompt: Event meal provided by the group: ____
questions.explanation: 来电者说家人会自己带午餐，不用安排餐饮。
工作人员说侧门与街道齐平，从这里进门就能找到电梯。
工作人员要求来电者在网站填写预订表，表内需说明桌子怎么摆。

questions.prompt: What does the centre ask groups to do if they use its cups and plates?
options: Wash them and put them back.
Leave them in the room for staff.
questions.answer: Wash them and put them back.
questions.explanation: 厨房餐具免费使用，但离开前需要清洗并放回原处。

questions.prompt: How will the group get into the room on Sunday?
options: They will collect a key from the office on Friday.
A staff member will open the room when they arrive.
They will receive a door code by email.
questions.answer: A staff member will open the room when they arrive.
questions.explanation: 周日下午有人值班，到前台找工作人员开门即可。
